summary: The PulseSoc Home feed is the main social surface for posts, creator updates, discovery, and quick navigation into the wider PulseSoc galaxy.
where_to_find_it: Open PulseSoc and tap Home in the bottom navigation.
how_to_use_it: Scroll the feed, open posts, react, comment, share, save, follow creators, and use entry points for Reels, Status, Messenger, Search, and Profile.
common_questions: Where do I see posts?
How do I react to a post?
How do I find creators?
troubleshooting: If the feed looks stale, refresh the page or reopen PulseSoc.
If media does not load, check network connectivity and app permissions.
safety_notes: Do not share passwords, recovery phrases, or private keys in posts or comments.

summary: Reels is PulseSoc's immersive vertical video surface and the only live-watching surface for PulseSoc Live.
where_to_find_it: Tap Reels in the bottom navigation or tap Join Live anywhere in PulseSoc.
how_to_use_it: Swipe vertically through videos and Live items, react, comment, share, save, follow creators, and join active Live sessions inside Reels.
common_questions: Where do I watch Live?
How do I join a Live?
Why did Join Live open Reels?
troubleshooting: If playback is silent, check mute state and device volume.
If a Live has ended, use replay if available.
safety_notes: Report harmful Live content using the More or report control.

summary: Status is PulseSoc's cinematic story surface for short-lived photo, video, music, and text updates.
where_to_find_it: Tap Create and choose Status, or open the Status viewer from a creator's story.
how_to_use_it: Add a photo, video, text, or music, choose privacy, then publish. Status is designed around one creator identity and one soundtrack.
common_questions: How do I create a Status?
How long does a Status last?
How do I add music?
troubleshooting: If a video does not play, check browser autoplay and network.
If upload fails, retry from a stable connection.
safety_notes: Review privacy before posting sensitive personal moments.

summary: Messenger V3 is the secure conversation hub for direct chats, group chats, media, voice messages, Pulse AI, and audio or video Pulses.
where_to_find_it: Tap Messages in the bottom navigation.
how_to_use_it: Open a conversation, type a message, attach media, send voice messages, start audio/video Pulses, or open the Conversation Control Center from the More menu.
common_questions: How do I send a voice message?
Where is Pulse AI?
How do I search a chat?
troubleshooting: If messages do not send, check connection and retry.
If media cannot load, retry the media or reopen the conversation.
safety_notes: Only share sensitive information with trusted contacts.

summary: Audio communication starts as a Pulse from Messenger and uses the PulseSoc Communications Engine.
where_to_find_it: Open a Messenger conversation and tap the phone icon in the header.
how_to_use_it: Tap the phone icon, wait for the recipient to answer, then use mic, speaker, minimize, and end controls during the Pulse.
common_questions: How do I start an audio call?
Why does it say Pulse?
How do I mute?
troubleshooting: If the Pulse cannot start, check the displayed error reason.
Allow microphone permission when prompted.
safety_notes: Do not accept unexpected calls from suspicious accounts.

summary: Video Pulses allow face-to-face communication from Messenger with camera, mic, speaker, and flip-camera controls.
where_to_find_it: Open a Messenger conversation and tap the video icon in the header.
how_to_use_it: Tap the video icon, allow camera and microphone permissions, and use the call controls during the Pulse.
common_questions: How do I start a video call?
How do I turn camera off?
How do I flip camera?
troubleshooting: If camera does not start, check browser permissions.
If camera state looks wrong, end and start a new Pulse after permissions are corrected.
safety_notes: Video only with people you trust; report harassment or abuse.

summary: Pulse AI is a normal Messenger conversation with the Galaxy Assistant. It helps users understand PulseSoc, troubleshoot features, and learn safety practices.
where_to_find_it: Open Messenger and choose the Pulse AI conversation row.
how_to_use_it: Ask questions naturally. Pulse AI can answer PulseSoc navigation questions, explain features, help with security education, and search live sources when current information is needed.
common_questions: What can Pulse AI do?
Can Pulse AI read my chats?
How do I clear Pulse AI memory?
troubleshooting: If Pulse AI is unavailable, try again later; normal Messenger remains unaffected.
If memory is disabled, personalization will be limited.
safety_notes: Pulse AI does not secretly read private chats or learn from private conversations without explicit opt-in.

summary: PulseSoc Music powers sounds, songs, emerging artists, Status soundtracks, and music identity across PulseSoc.
where_to_find_it: Open Music surfaces, Status music controls, or music signatures inside content.
how_to_use_it: Discover songs, use sounds in Status, save audio, and explore music trends where available.
common_questions: How do I add music to Status?
Where do trending songs appear?
troubleshooting: If music does not play, check mute state and browser autoplay.
If a sound is missing, it may not be available yet.
safety_notes: Respect creator and music rights when sharing audio.

summary: PulseSoc notifications are centralized records with preferences, mute rules, privacy previews, delivery jobs, and deep links.
where_to_find_it: Use the notification bell, notification center, Messenger settings, or device notification settings.
how_to_use_it: Open notifications, mark them read, use deep links, and manage push, email, SMS, preview, and quiet-hour preferences.
common_questions: How do I turn off lock-screen notifications?
Why did I not get a push?
How do unread badges work?
troubleshooting: Check browser/PWA notification permission.
Check muted conversations and push settings.
safety_notes: Disable previews on lock screen if privacy matters.

summary: Crypto alerts notify users when their own configured alert conditions trigger.
where_to_find_it: Open Crypto Command Center and choose Manage My Alerts.
how_to_use_it: Create alerts for assets and thresholds, then pause, resume, edit, duplicate, delete, or inspect history.
common_questions: How do I manage crypto alerts?
Why did an alert fire?
How do I stop duplicates?
troubleshooting: If an alert fires but is not visible, use Manage My Alerts and check source-of-truth records.
If push is missing, check notification permission and device token status.
safety_notes: Crypto alerts are educational signals, not investment advice.

summary: Market alerts and Market Pulse surface major index, macro, ETF, volatility, Treasury, dollar, commodity, Fed, CPI, jobs, and earnings signals when configured and supported.
where_to_find_it: Open Market Signals, then use Signal Preferences to manage delivery.
how_to_use_it: Use Market Pulse for major market signals and confidence-labeled forecasts; manage delivery frequency, thresholds, followed assets, and urgent-only preferences.
common_questions: What is Market Pulse?
Can I get stock market news?
What is the S&P 500 doing today?
Is the market risky right now?
What does VIX mean?
troubleshooting: If live market sources are unavailable, Pulse AI can still explain general market concepts.
If signals feel noisy, use urgent-only alerts or raise your confidence threshold.
safety_notes: Market content is educational and not financial advice.
Pulse AI must not tell users to buy now, sell now, or promise profit.

summary: Pulse AI can explain broad market conditions for S&P 500, NASDAQ, Dow Jones, Russell 2000, VIX, Treasury yields, USD index, gold, oil, sector ETFs, Fed/CPI/jobs reports, and major earnings events.
where_to_find_it: Open Market Signals, Pulse Alerts, Pulse Forecasts, or ask Pulse AI in Messenger.
how_to_use_it: Ask questions like 'What is the S&P 500 doing today?', 'Is the market risky right now?', 'Explain today's market signal', or 'What does VIX mean?'. Pulse AI should use safe terms like breakout watch, support test, momentum improving, risk elevated, pullback risk rising, and confirmation needed.
common_questions: What is the S&P 500 doing today?
Is the market risky right now?
Why did I get this S&P 500 alert?
What should beginners watch in the market?
What does VIX mean?
troubleshooting: If live market data is unavailable, Pulse AI should say live sources are unavailable and explain general concepts.
If a user asks for buy/sell advice, Pulse AI should redirect to educational market intelligence.
safety_notes: Use 'market intelligence' language, not trading commands.
Do not promise profit or personalized investment outcomes.
Say: Pulse AI provides educational market intelligence only. This is not financial advice.

summary: Pulse Alerts, Forecasts, and Daily Briefing filter world, market, crypto, security, technology, creator, music, and PulseSoc signals into useful Pulses.
where_to_find_it: Open Alerts, Forecasts, Daily Briefing, or Signal Preferences from Mission Control.
how_to_use_it: Review signals, save useful items, set frequency and confidence thresholds in Signal Preferences, and give feedback so PulseSoc learns what matters.
common_questions: What are Intelligence Streams?
How do I mute a stream?
What does confidence mean?
troubleshooting: If a stream feels noisy, raise confidence threshold or switch to digest mode.
safety_notes: The engine does not learn from private conversations without explicit permission.

summary: Manage My Alerts is the control surface for every crypto alert that can fire for the user.
where_to_find_it: Open Crypto Command Center, then My Alerts or Manage My Alerts.
how_to_use_it: View alert cards, pause/resume, edit, duplicate, delete, and inspect trigger history.
common_questions: Why do I see only one alert?
How do I pause SOL alerts?
How do I inspect history?
troubleshooting: If notifications show ghost alerts, report it; firing alerts should always be manageable.
safety_notes: Avoid trading decisions based only on alerts.

summary: The Conversation Control Center is the settings console for a Messenger conversation.
where_to_find_it: Open a Messenger conversation and use the More menu to open the control center.
how_to_use_it: Manage search, members, notifications, appearance, privacy, media, security, productivity, storage, accessibility, and danger-zone actions.
common_questions: Where are chat settings?
How do I mute a chat?
How do I change theme?
troubleshooting: If a setting is unavailable, check whether the current chat type or device supports it.
safety_notes: Destructive actions require confirmation.

summary: Profile controls identity, avatar, presence, posts, creator information, and user-facing preferences.
where_to_find_it: Tap Profile in the bottom navigation.
how_to_use_it: Update avatar, bio, profile information, privacy, creator status, and related settings where available.
common_questions: How do I change my avatar?
Where is my profile?
troubleshooting: If an avatar does not update, reload after upload and check image format.
safety_notes: Avoid posting private contact or recovery details in your public bio.

summary: Privacy settings control previews, read receipts, typing, visibility, lock-screen content, and conversation privacy where supported.
where_to_find_it: Open Settings, Messenger conversation controls, or notification preferences.
how_to_use_it: Adjust previews, lock-screen visibility, read receipts, online status, and privacy options according to your needs.
common_questions: How do I hide message previews?
How do I turn off read receipts?
troubleshooting: If device lock-screen previews still appear, check both PulseSoc and OS notification settings.
safety_notes: Use private previews on shared or public devices.

summary: Security settings help protect account login, sessions, password changes, devices, and recovery.
where_to_find_it: Open account settings or security center surfaces where available.
how_to_use_it: Use a strong password, enable 2FA if available, review devices, sign out unknown sessions, and respond to security alerts.
common_questions: How do I secure my account?
What if I got a login alert?
troubleshooting: If you suspect compromise, change your password, sign out other sessions, and contact support.
safety_notes: PulseSoc will never ask for passwords, private keys, seed phrases, or one-time codes in chat.

summary: Creator tools support content growth, insights, Premium workflows, verification, and future creator monetization features.
where_to_find_it: Open Profile, Creator Dashboard, Premium, or relevant creator surfaces.
how_to_use_it: Track growth, use best posting-time insights, manage creator settings, and explore creator recommendations where available.
common_questions: How do I grow on PulseSoc?
Where are creator insights?
troubleshooting: If analytics are unavailable, the account may not have creator access yet.
safety_notes: Avoid engagement manipulation or misleading promotions.

summary: Premium and Founder access unlock higher-value PulseSoc identity, creator, profile, and platform enhancements where available.
where_to_find_it: Open Premium, billing, or profile upgrade surfaces.
how_to_use_it: Review plan benefits, complete checkout only through official PulseSoc flows, and manage billing or subscription status.
common_questions: What is Founder Premium?
How do I manage billing?
troubleshooting: If payment status is wrong, rely on verified provider/webhook status rather than frontend success alone.
safety_notes: Do not trust payment links sent by strangers.

summary: Verification badges help identify approved or trusted accounts according to PulseSoc verification rules.
where_to_find_it: Profile, creator surfaces, or account verification center where available.
how_to_use_it: Submit verification information if eligible and check status in the verification center.
common_questions: How do I get verified?
Why was verification rejected?
troubleshooting: If verification needs more information, follow the official request in the verification center.
safety_notes: PulseSoc will not ask for passwords or payment secrets for verification.

summary: PulseSoc Live starts from creator/live setup tools and is watched only inside Reels.
where_to_find_it: Start Live from creator/live tools; watch Live from Reels or Join Live links.
how_to_use_it: Creators configure title, category, destination, camera, mic, and readiness before starting. Viewers join in Reels.
common_questions: Where do I watch Live?
Why does Join Live open Reels?
troubleshooting: If a destination requires setup, connect the platform or use PulseSoc Live when ready.
safety_notes: Do not expose stream keys or private broadcast credentials.

summary: Search helps users find people, conversations, rooms, posts, and platform surfaces.
where_to_find_it: Use search bars in Home, Messenger, or relevant PulseSoc surfaces.
how_to_use_it: Type a name, topic, room, or query and use filters where available.
common_questions: How do I find Pulse AI?
How do I find a chat?
troubleshooting: If search fails, check spelling or use a broader term.
safety_notes: Do not search for or share private data that belongs to others.

summary: Trending content surfaces popular posts, music, topics, creators, and communities where supported.
where_to_find_it: Home, Reels, Music, Discovery, Pulse Alerts, or Daily Briefing.
how_to_use_it: Explore trends, follow creators, save content, and use insights for creator planning.
common_questions: Where are trends?
How do I use trending music?
troubleshooting: If trends look stale, refresh or check network connection.
safety_notes: Trend visibility does not guarantee quality or safety; use judgment.

summary: PulseSoc communities, groups, and rooms support shared conversations and topic-based collaboration.
where_to_find_it: Messenger groups, Rooms tabs, communities, or relevant navigation entries.
how_to_use_it: Join or create groups, chat with members, manage group settings, and follow room rules.
common_questions: How do I create a group?
Where are rooms?
troubleshooting: If you cannot access a group, check invite, membership, or admin permissions.
safety_notes: Report abuse and avoid sharing sensitive information in group spaces.

summary: Reporting lets users flag harassment, spam, scams, impersonation, harmful content, or abuse.
where_to_find_it: Use More menus on profiles, posts, messages, Live, or conversations where available.
how_to_use_it: Choose report, select a reason, include safe context, and submit. Admin/moderation review can follow.
common_questions: How do I report spam?
How do I report a scam?
troubleshooting: If report submission fails, retry or use support.
safety_notes: If immediate danger exists, contact local emergency or trusted authorities.

summary: Blocking helps prevent unwanted contact, messages, and noisy notifications from a user.
where_to_find_it: Open user profile, conversation controls, or safety options.
how_to_use_it: Choose Block User, confirm, and PulseSoc should suppress normal social notifications/messages where supported.
common_questions: How do I block someone?
Will they know?
troubleshooting: If blocked content still appears, refresh and report the issue.
safety_notes: Block and report threatening or suspicious accounts.

summary: Account recovery helps users regain access safely after forgotten passwords, suspicious logins, or device loss.
where_to_find_it: Use login, password reset, or security/account settings.
how_to_use_it: Use official recovery flows, verify email or phone when required, change password, and review active sessions.
common_questions: How do I reset my password?
What if I lost access?
troubleshooting: If reset email is missing, check spam, wait a minute, and retry only through official PulseSoc pages.
safety_notes: Never share reset links, one-time codes, or passwords with anyone.

summary: Password reset lets a user change account access through official verified flows.
where_to_find_it: Use Forgot Password on the login page.
how_to_use_it: Enter the account email, open the official reset link, choose a strong new password, and sign in again.
common_questions: Where is forgot password?
Why did reset fail?
troubleshooting: If reset fails, check link expiration and request a new reset link.
safety_notes: PulseSoc support will not ask for your password.

summary: PulseSoc iOS availability uses the official App Store page and PulseSoc action buttons for download/share prompts.
where_to_find_it: Use the App Store app, Pulse Alerts action buttons, or Pulse AI guidance.
how_to_use_it: Tap Download PulseSoc, Open PulseSoc, Share PulseSoc, Invite Friends, or Join the Galaxy when those buttons appear. Pulse AI should show or describe the official download action instead of dumping a raw URL unless the user explicitly asks.
common_questions: Where can I download PulseSoc?
How do I share PulseSoc?
Why is the app not visible?
troubleshooting: If the app is not visible, check storefront region, release status, pricing/availability, agreements, and propagation delay.
safety_notes: Install only from official PulseSoc/App Store links.
Do not trust random download links sent by strangers.

summary: PulseSoc can run as a PWA/browser app with mobile-safe UI, service worker support, and push readiness where supported.
where_to_find_it: Open PulseSoc in a supported mobile browser and install/add to home screen if available.
how_to_use_it: Use the app from browser or home screen; enable notifications when prompted after reading the explanation.
common_questions: How do I install the PWA?
Why does it feel like an app?
troubleshooting: If old UI appears, clear cache or use reset/reload tools when provided.
safety_notes: Only grant browser permissions from official PulseSoc domains.

summary: Push notifications use device/browser tokens and provider adapters to reach users outside the open app.
where_to_find_it: Notification settings, browser/PWA permission prompts, device settings.
how_to_use_it: Enable notifications, keep device token registered, and manage channel preferences.
common_questions: Why no push?
How do I enable notifications?
troubleshooting: Check browser permission, PWA install state, device token, quiet hours, muted chats, and push provider configuration.
safety_notes: Use privacy previews if lock-screen content is sensitive.

summary: Lock-screen notifications appear when push delivery is configured, user preferences allow it, and the device/browser supports it.
where_to_find_it: Device notification settings and PulseSoc notification preferences.
how_to_use_it: Enable push and lock-screen display, choose preview privacy, and keep device subscriptions active.
common_questions: How do I turn off lock-screen previews?
Why did only comments appear?
troubleshooting: If only some notifications appear, check whether each event creates a push delivery job.
safety_notes: Turn off previews for private chats on shared devices.

summary: The Growth Center is PulseSoc's native Growth Engine. Every account is automatically provisioned with a Growth Account, campaign workspace, promotion wallet, audience profile, analytics container, conversion tracking ID, Growth Score, and Pulse AI Growth Advisor readiness.
where_to_find_it: Open /pulse/growth or use promote buttons where available. Pulse AI can also guide users into Growth Center.
how_to_use_it: Ask Pulse AI to help promote a business, Reel, marketplace listing, music, event, live stream, or creator profile. Growth Center shows campaigns, audience, budget, performance, insights, billing readiness, promotion credits, and reports without requiring a setup wizard.
common_questions: How do I grow my reach?
Can Pulse AI promote my music?
Where is my promotion wallet?
How do I promote a business?
troubleshooting: If Growth Center says it is preparing, refresh after a moment; provisioning is automatic and resumable.
If billing is inactive, funding and live charging are not configured yet.
Campaign delivery still requires moderation, budget, review, and safety checks.
safety_notes: PulseSoc should never expose private targeting data or internal promotion API keys.
Promotion and billing remain review-gated, fraud-checked, and owner-scoped.
